params.name: yearlyNumberDigits
params.description: The number of digits for the yearly number (variable $ny). If the number of digits are lower than this, the number will be prepended by zeroes (e.g. 0001 if 4 digits). Defaults to 1.

endpoints.description: Creates a new tax code. Returns either a success or multiple error messages (for each issue).

params.name: code
params.description: A short code to identify the tax code.

params.name: components
params.description: The components of the tax code, up to two possible.

params.name: rates
params.description: Tax rates that are valid from a given date. Add a new tax rate here if the official tax rate changes. Exactly one tax rate must exist without a valid from date.

params.name: description
params.description: A description for the tax code. This can contain localized text. To add values in multiple languages, use the XML format like this: <values><de>German text</de><en>English text</en></values>

params.name: documentName
params.description: The name for the tax code displayed on documents (seen by customers). If isDisplayTaxRate is set, this name doesn't have to include the tax rate percentage, it will be automatically appended.

params.name: isDisplayTaxRate
params.description: Whether to automatically append the current tax rate to the document name (see documentName ) or not. Possible values: true, false.

params.name: isInactive
params.description: Mark the tax code as inactive. This means that the tax code is greyed out and no longer suggested. Tax codes already in use cannot be deleted, but you can always set them as inactive.

endpoints.description: Deletes one or multiple tax codes. Note that you cannot delete tax codes that are being used. Instead use Update tax code to deactivate the tax code. Returns either a success or error message.

params.name: ids
params.description: The IDs of the selected entries, comma-separated.

params.name: id
